sonnet.problem: Card 15's question already says the Philistines might say "come on up", and card 14 gives the "wait until we come to you" option. Card 17's right answer, "Come on up and we will teach you a lesson", is therefore signalled by earlier cards.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The question says Jonathan "makes it to the top of the cliff". Verse 13 says only that Jonathan climbed up on his hands and feet. It does not say he reached the top of a cliff, so this setting is added.
sonnet.rule: No added settings. No setting the text doesn't give.
